_readme: Known-bad fixture for the setting-description-length gate (D-021). Not a real environment.

settingRows.description: D-021 fixture. rev_description was widened from 500 to 1000 on 2026-08-21, which made the old 770-character padding fit and turned this negative test into a gate that could not fail; the padding is regenerated from the declared MaxLength, not pinned to a number. This sentence pads the description well past the 1000-character MaxLength that rev_setting.rev_description declares in Entities/rev_setting/Entity.xml.
